mapper.insert: INSERT INTO system_notifications (id, type, title, content, data, is_read, recipient_id, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{type}, #{title}, #{content}, #{data, typeHandler=com.example.backend.config.JsonNodeTypeHandler}, #{isRead}, #{recipientId}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE system_notifications SET type = #{type}, title = #{title}, content = #{content}, data = #{data, typeHandler=com.example.backend.config.JsonNodeTypeHandler}, is_read = #{isRead}, recipient_id = #{recipientId} WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE system_notifications SET is_read = TRUE
AND recipient_id = #{recipientId}
